title: Split-bank configuration
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, a Boolean list $s$, an optional state of $M$, and a Boolean output list, define a configuration for $M$ on empty input with that state and output, input-head position $1$, every work tape equal to the catalog polynomial tape of length parameter $|s|+1$, and every work-head position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
